parameters.content:
## Client Brand - Meta Performance Monitor

Standalone workflow that runs every Monday at 8 AM.

**What it does:**
- Pulls last 7 days of Meta performance data
- Automatically pauses underperforming ads
- Emails a plain English weekly report
- Replaces manual Meta Ads Manager check-ins

**Pair with:** Client Brand - Meta Ad Automation workflow

parameters.subject: Client Brand - Failed to Pause Underperforming Ads
parameters.message:
=

Failed to Pause Underperforming Ads

The following ads could not be automatically paused and need manual attention in Meta Ads Manager:

  • Ad IDs: {{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.underperforming_ad_ids.join(", ") }}

parameters.subject: =Client Brand Weekly Ad Report - {{ $now.toFormat("MMMM d, yyyy") }}
parameters.message:
=

Client Brand Weekly Ad Performance Report

Reporting Period: Last 7 Days

Overall Performance:

  • Total Spend: ${{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.total_spend }}
  • Total Impressions: {{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.total_impressions.toLocaleString() }}
  • Total Clicks: {{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.total_clicks.toLocaleString() }}
  • Total Reach: {{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.total_reach.toLocaleString() }}
  • Overall CTR: {{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.overall_ctr }}%

Individual Ad Performance:

{{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.ad_details.map(ad => `
${ad.ad_name}
Spend: $${ad.spend} | Impressions: ${ad.impressions.toLocaleString()} | Clicks: ${ad.clicks} | CTR: ${ad.ctr}% | CPM: $${ad.cpm} | Reach: ${ad.reach.toLocaleString()}
Status: ${ad.status.toUpperCase()}${ad.reason ? " - " + ad.reason : ""}
`).join("") }}

Automated Actions:

{{ $("Analyze Performance").item.json.paused_ads.length > 0 ? `

✅ The following ads were automatically paused due to underperformance:

    ${$("Analyze Performance").item.json.paused_ads.map(id => "
  • Ad ID: " + id + "
    • ").join("")}
` : "

No ads were paused this week.

" }}

⚠️ Reminder:

Draft ads created this week are in PAUSED status and require manual review and approval in Meta Ads Manager before going live.

This is an automated report. Please review Meta Ads Manager for full details.
